u: memslap is a load generation and benchmark tool for memcached(1) servers. It generates configurable workload such as threads, concurrencies, connections, run time, overwrite, miss rate, key size, value size, get/set proportion, expected throughput, and so on.

You can specify servers via the option:
--servers

or via the environment variable:
`MEMCACHED_SERVERS`

For a full list of operations run the tool with:
--help
To find out more information please check: 'http://libmemcached.org/ <http://libmemcached.org/>'_
